summary: Independent review of Samaveda Uttarārcika p04/ch04 chunk 1 (verses 830-885, 56 units). 40 issues: 9 error, 31 minor. Main errors: kratu rendered सामर्थ्य in Hindi (838, 848); Hindi/English disagreements (840 'it' dropped, 845 sma dropped and ambiguous syntax, 871 object/subject of pavasva); missing text_flags for printed doubled consonant (850); token/word misalignment (877 garbhamā/ā dadhuḥ); navīyasī wrongly labelled superlative (884) and an invented stem cikitvin (884). Minor: glossary alignments (vāja = prize in English, barhis = कुशासन, ava = help, loka = space), unsupported additions ('approaching', 'भी', 'जो'), denominative saparya-. No regrouping suggested; 856 (second pāda of a different length) is kept as printed. Manual decisions: dharman in 857 (dharma vs ordinance, glossary OPEN, left unchanged), indu in 841 (this draft 'drop', p01 505 'Indu'), tejas in 876 (Hindi collides with varcas = तेज), 848 ṛtāvṛdhau, 877 reading of pṛśniḥ/agriyaḥ/ukṣā against p02 596. Suggested glossary additions: suparṇa = eagle (बाज़), viḥ = bird (पक्षी); vāja English = prize, Hindi वाज; ava/ūti = help (सहायता); saparyati = serves (सेवा करना), āvivāsati = honours (आदर करना); loka (in lokakṛt) = space (स्थान); barhis Hindi = कुशासन everywhere; upastuta = praising; brahmī = of the sacred word; navīyas = newer (comparative); cikitvit as compound stem of cikitvas; brahmaṇaspati kept as a name; tejas = brilliance with its own Hindi word; pitṛ = fathers (पितर); vicarṣaṇi = surveyor (सर्वदर्शी) and vicakṣaṇa = far-seeing (दूरदर्शी). All layers remain an unreviewed AI draft until a person has read them.
